requirements.title: Canonical pipeline reuse
requirements.obligation: PDF/XLSX reuse batch/preview/review; no parallel financial pipeline.

requirements.title: XLSX explicit safe parsing
requirements.obligation: Explicit sheet/column mapping; active content never executed; limits enforced.

requirements.title: Versioned PDF parser registry
requirements.obligation: Deterministic institution/emitter + class + layout/version parser registry.

requirements.title: PDF fail closed
requirements.obligation: Unknown, ambiguous, protected or invalid PDFs do not create suggestions/effects.

requirements.title: Canonical account domain
requirements.obligation: Bank statements require canonical account resolution and preserve movement semantics.

requirements.title: Canonical card domain
requirements.obligation: Card invoices preserve cardId/instrument/period and delegate to canonical purchase/invoice domain.

requirements.title: Instrument/period review
requirements.obligation: Ambiguous card instrument requires review; invoice period is validated and preserved.

requirements.title: Shared review queue
requirements.obligation: Shared suggestion/review contract is extended instead of creating a parallel queue.

requirements.title: Preview before effect
requirements.obligation: Preview has no persistent financial effect and approval revalidates live references.

requirements.title: Raw-input privacy
requirements.obligation: Raw file/unneeded cells/fragments are not persisted or exposed in logs/audit/errors.

requirements.title: No double accounting
requirements.obligation: Invoice payment/summary/total are not converted into purchases or duplicated effects.

requirements.title: Single structured source
requirements.obligation: Approval uses reviewed structured payload and does not reparse raw PDF/XLSX.

requirements.title: Clear UI origin/layout
requirements.obligation: UI distinguishes bank statement/card invoice and recognized parser/layout.

requirements.title: Required test matrix
requirements.obligation: Domain/API/integration tests cover positive and negative structured-import scenarios.

requirements.title: Parser extensibility
requirements.obligation: New layouts can be added with parser/fixture without changing financial core.
